title: The Space Between Moments – Becoming
statement:
When does one moment become another?

I don’t think it ever does.

Becoming explores the space in between — the subtle threshold where one state quietly shifts into another.

More than 150,000 particles move, gather, separate, and transform, creating forms that seem present for a moment before changing again. Nothing is completely fixed. Even as a form begins to emerge, it is already becoming something else.

As light and color move through the particles, the atmosphere shifts with them, reflecting the way our emotions and experiences are constantly changing — sometimes visibly, sometimes almost without us noticing.

The work unfolds as a continuous loop, without a defined beginning or end. It is a reflection on impermanence, presence, and the quiet transformations that shape who we are.

Perhaps we spend more of our lives in this space between moments than we realize.
